topic: EXP-597 station-attribution patch verification (Tsumeb → SAA-region / TTB)

holes_found.description: Cross-field terminology drift: the `finding` field still contains 'at Tsumeb' ('~30 nT/yr at Tsumeb') while the patched detail_verdict_text and detail_evidence now consistently use 'SAA-region stations' and 'TTB (Tatuoca, Brazil)'. EXP-597 scoped its patches to detail_verdict_text and detail_evidence only, leaving the finding field out-of-sync. Not verdict-affecting — the finding is a brief summary label — but it introduces a minor inconsistency within WIN-037.
holes_found.proposed_fix: In data/wins.json WIN-037.finding, change 'at Tsumeb' to 'in the SAA region' to match the corrected detail fields. E.g.: 'SAA-only data (~30 nT/yr in the SAA region)'

summary_for_decider: EXP-597 patches verified: all 4 landed correctly in data/wins.json WIN-037 (detail_verdict_text ×2, detail_evidence ×2). No seam artifacts, no stale 'Tsumeb' in patched fields, patched sentences read cleanly. One minor cross-field drift: the `finding` field still says '~30 nT/yr at Tsumeb' while the patched fields now say 'SAA-region stations' and 'TTB (Tatuoca, Brazil)'. Straightforward one-word fix.
